name: Sheraton 22M, 1BDR
headline: The 1 BDR Cobalt Cube| 5 min to CAI Airport
summary: This elegant blue studio features a queen size bed, a spacious bathroom, a dining corner and a nice kitchenette. The studio apartment is perfect for small families and business travelers and is managed by Xuru Stays.

description.Space: This deep blue studio is perfect for small families and business travelers.  The studio features a queen size comfortable bed with a working desk. It also features a fully loaded kitchenette, microwave, a stove top with cooking utensils, a kettle and a Nespresso coffee machine. Additionally, guests can enjoy a 55 inch smart TV for further personal entertainment at the bedroom and a 43 inch smart TV at the dining corner.
description.Access: Guests have access to the entire apartment.
description.Interaction: Guests can text and call us anytime they need assistance. We'll be happy to address any issues right away.
description.Neighborhood:
The neighborhood is full of life with plenty of street food options (the apartment is quite and peaceful though) 

- Banks and other services are also within walking distance. 

- Cairo Complex is within 15 min walking distance and is packed with hangouts. 
- Giza Pyramids is a 50 min drive
- Downtown Cairo is a 30 min drive 
- New Cairo is a 15 min drive
- Cairo International Airport is a 5 min drive.
description.Transit: We provide concierge services that include airport transfers and private day tours.
description.Notes:
Please note the following: 
- Smoking is only allowed outside the building (a fine of $100 will be imposed when smoking indoors) 
- Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests will be granted entry. 
- Free of charge street parking is available.

location_address1: 81 Ashbelya, Sheraton Al Matar, El Nozha, Cairo Governorate 11780
agreement:
Kindly note that a damage deposit of USD 100 (or the equivalent in EGP) is required. The payment is collected online as part of the reservation payment and will be reimbursed on the checkout day, provided no damages are incurred.
  • Smoking (including shisha) inside the unit is strictly not allowed. However it is allowed in the unit’s balcony (if applicable). A fine of $100 may be imposed in case of smoking indoors.
 • Partying, excessive noise and public alcohol drinking is not allowed. In case of violations, security will be notified and appropriate strict actions will be taken. 
 • Visitors are not allowed, only confirmed guests stated in the reservation will be granted entry. 
• Egyptian & Arab couples ONLY are required to provide proof of marriage according to Egyptian law. Guests are required to send their IDs or passports to the email (id@xurustays.com) or (id.elgouna@xurustays.com) as per the local regulations.
• El Gouna entry permits require 48 hours to be issued, in case guest IDs and passports are sent less than 48 hours before check in date, entry permits are subject to delay or may not be granted. (In case of disapproval from community security office, guests will be fully refunded).
 • Cancellation more than 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 10% of the total price of the stay.
 • Cancellation between 15 days and 30 days before the arrival date, we keep 50% of the total price of the stay. 
• Cancellation between 7 days and 15 days before the arrival date, we keep 75% of the total price of the stay.
• Less than 7 days, we keep 100% of the price of the stay
• Pets are not allowed, in case of violation, Xuru Stays has the right to cancel the reservation with no refund. 

Thank you for choosing our home for your Holiday.
We hope that you have a pleasant stay.

Xuru Stays

Negative:
Unfortunately, an unpleasant booking experience. 

After completing the online booking, days before my trip, I received messages from the host's private phone number, not the number that was listed on this booking. The message stated that getting a taxi or an uber at the airport will be complicated, and he is selling rides. 

It gave me an icky feeling, and it is not really allowed for hosts to use customer's whatsapp contacts for that. Then I received more whatsapp messages from another number (also not listed on this booking), eventually claiming to be THREE other people from this company 'Xuru Stays',  also claiming to be texting me in regards to my booking, asking for my passport information and arrival information, and passport information of people travelling with me (I made this booking for myself only, so it's even sketchier they would want me to send them other people's passports on whatsapp - I am wondering if this was their way of finding out if I really am going to be a girl staying there by myself). 

When I didn't send them any passport info on whatsapp, they even asked for my passport info directly on booking.com messages - there's literally a disclaimer on booking.com warning against this :D 

It definitely felt unprofessional and left me feeling cautious and not at ease with it, as a solo female traveller. I reached out to booking.com for assistance, and unfortunately they were slow to respond and seemed understaffed and unable to resolve this on time. I ended up booking another place in Cairo and had a wonderful stay there, and I did not show up at this place, yet apparently they checked me in without me actually showing up. I was ready for booking.com to receive the no-show fee, but instead, it seems the host falsely checked me in to receive the full payment. 

Lots of red flags, just stay cautious if you are booking this place!
